I'm closing out the filing package on the Tanya Mitchell delinquency and I want the balance and case status clean before it moves, because it goes into the court file and in front of the owner. I've been buried across the rent roll and my read on where her case stands is a few weeks stale, so I don't trust my own memory on the particulars.

There are two things I need you to pin down for me. The first is what Tanya genuinely owes us right now. I set up her payment plan when she fell behind and was under the impression the back rent had mostly been squared away since, but I am not putting a number into the filing package that I haven't checked against what is actually in QuickBooks myself. Whatever the real outstanding figure is, walk it back to the underlying charges so I know it is the clean number and we are not double-counting any credit or adjustment applied along the way.

The second is where the eviction really stands today. Find out the current picture for me, because last I tracked it we were about at the hearing stage, and that was a while ago. Tell me plainly what has happened and what comes next: whether we have truly filed the petition yet or are still short of that, and confirm we have the owner's authorization on file the way we should.

I also need to know whether we are clear to release her unit back for make-ready, or whether it has to hold. I don't want the crew mobilizing on a unit they can't touch yet, or us marketing something we can't deliver.

Once you have the full picture, get our make-ready record for the unit updated to the real current state, not the stale note in there. Leave a short note on the eviction ticket so the trail is current. Drop the make-ready team a heads-up in our channel on where things landed. And draft me an email to the owner covering the balance, the eviction status, and whether we can touch the unit yet, so I can look it over before it goes.

If anything I've assumed here turns out to be off, tell me plainly. I would far rather catch it now than have the owner or the court be the one to point it out.
I will start by searching for Tanya Mitchell in
QuickBooks, Linear, Airtable, Slack, and company files to gather all relevant details regarding her account balance, eviction status, unit
number, and owner details.

Patricia Nguyen
Property Manager
Star Property Management
